Texte · Well, where’s the proof?
Titre H2 · What are hydrolyzed collagen peptides?
Paragraphe · Remember what we said about the structur
settings.text: Remember what we said about the structure of a single collagen protein? That's right: it's a triple helix of 3 amino acid chains. But what we didn't mention was that each of these chains is over 1,400 amino acids long. Meaning? Collagen is a HUGE (yes, all-caps) molecule. And due to its size, your body may have difficulties absorbing collagen.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This, in turn, limits the extent of well
settings.text: This, in turn, limits the extent of wellness benefits you’d see from collagen supplementation. So how can we change that? Answer: using hydrolysis to make collagen molecules smaller.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This process uses water and enzymes to b
settings.text: This process uses water and enzymes to break the chemical bonds between proteins — chopping collagen molecules into shorter, easily absorbed amino acids. And there you have it: hydrolyzed collagen peptides.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · Do they even get to where they need to b
settings.text: Do they even get to where they need to be?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · But wait: won't your body simply digest
settings.text: But wait: won't your body simply digest smaller collagen peptides into single amino acids? How's that different from if you were to eat any other protein source? While it was thought that all proteins and peptides were completely broken down into their constituent amino acids in the digestive tract, recent research shows that this is not the case for collagen.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Several collagen dipeptides and tripepti
settings.text: Several collagen dipeptides and tripeptides bypass complete digestion, leaving as many as 10% remaining intact as they enter the bloodstream. The body will then shuttle these hydrolyzed bioactive peptides to "areas of need" (e.g., skin, joints, and gut) where they can exert their beneficial effects.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Bottom line? If your hydrolyzed collagen
settings.text: Bottom line? If your hydrolyzed collagen peptides are small enough to bypass digestion (less than 3kDa in molecular weight), you needn’t worry about their efficacy.
